# Project overview
submitnow (Bing-only) is a multilingual web UI for submitting URL batches to Bing via the IndexNow protocol. Requests are sent server-side and are not persisted.

# Tech stack
- Next.js App Router
- React + TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- OpenNext Cloudflare + Wrangler

# Core structure
- `app/`: Next.js App Router pages and layouts; locale routes live under `app/[locale]/`
- `components/`: shared UI components; feature components live in subfolders
- `actions/`: server actions for IndexNow submission and related workflows
- `lib/`, `hooks/`, `stores/`, `types/`: utilities, hooks, Zustand state, shared types
- `content/`, `blogs/`: MDX content
- `i18n/messages/`: translations
- `public/`: static assets
- `styles/`: Tailwind and global styles
- `open-next.config.ts`, `wrangler.jsonc`: Cloudflare build and deploy settings

# Common commands
```bash
pnpm dev
pnpm build
pnpm start
pnpm preview
pnpm deploy
pnpm lint
```

# Local setup
```bash
corepack enable
pnpm install
cp .env.example .env
pnpm dev
```

# IndexNow requirements
- Host a key file at `https://<host>/<key>.txt`
- File content must be the key only (plain text)

# Constraints and notes
- Only the Bing endpoint is supported (`https://www.bing.com/indexnow`)
- For public deployments, consider adding auth and rate limiting
- `package.json` declares Node.js 20.x as the engine version
- No automated test runner is configured; use `pnpm lint` and manual UI checks

# Deploy and preview
- `pnpm build` generates the OpenNext Cloudflare output
- `pnpm preview` runs `wrangler dev` for Workers preview
- `pnpm deploy` deploys via `wrangler deploy`
